title: Focused-DPO: Enhancing Code Generation Through Focused Preference Optimization on Error-Prone Points
authors_zh: Kechi Zhang, Ge Li, Jia Li, Yihong Dong, Jia Li, Zhi Jin（北京大学、清华大学）
paper_type_zh: 可执行偏好数据构造与细粒度优化研究
best_for_zh: 适合训练代码模型、且少量局部选择即可决定程序能否通过测试的读者。
one_line: Focused-DPO identifies error-prone code segments from executable preference pairs and gives those segments greater DPO influence.
Focused-DPO 从可执行偏好回答对中定位易错代码片段，并让这些片段在 DPO 中拥有更大影响。
why: It turns test-sensitive code differences into an explicit record field and optimization weight instead of averaging them with routine syntax.
inclusion_reason: It constructs preference records around executable high-impact code differences and changes DPO so those differences dominate the training signal.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Code candidates often share routine prefixes and suffixes yet fail because of a small divergent middle segment. Whole-sequence DPO gives routine and decisive tokens similar treatment, so it can dilute the signal from the decision that actually determines execution.

Focused-DPO asks how a preference pair can reveal the local code choice most responsible for correctness. It makes error localization part of both data construction and the loss, rather than assuming that every token in a chosen-rejected pair has equal training value.

代码候选常共享常规前缀和后缀，却会因一个很小的中间差异片段而失败。全序列 DPO 对常规与决定性词元给予近似处理，因此可能稀释真正决定执行结果的选择信号。

Focused-DPO 询问偏好回答对如何揭示最应对正确性负责的局部代码选择。它把错误定位同时放入数据构造和损失，而不是假定优选—劣选回答对中的每个词元都有相同训练价值。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The method finds two code candidates with shared context but different middle segments, then prefers the segment associated with stronger executable ranking. The shared context makes the middle difference interpretable as an error-prone point rather than a broad stylistic difference.

Focused-DPO amplifies the chosen and rejected middle terms in DPO while reducing reliance on a similar rejected suffix. The same preference pair therefore becomes a focused supervision record: training is asked to correct the high-impact local decision, not merely raise the likelihood of an entire solution.

该方法找到共享上下文但中间片段不同的两份代码候选，再偏好与更强可执行排序相关的片段。共享上下文使中间差异可被解释为易错点，而不是宽泛的文风差异。

Focused-DPO 放大 DPO 中优选与劣选中间片段的项，并降低对相似劣选后缀的依赖。因此，同一偏好回答对成为聚焦监督记录：训练被要求修正高影响局部决策，而不只是提高整个解答的概率。

title: Method
方法
html:
The pipeline extracts repository concepts, synthesizes problems, samples ten code candidates and tests, then ranks candidates with a PageRank-inspired score. Common-prefix and suffix matching splits each pair into prefix, divergent middle, and suffix; a score-gap-plus-shared-context criterion selects concentrated error points.

Each policy receives 5,000 selected training examples and 1,000 validation examples. The reported loss sets the middle weight to two, trains for ten epochs, and evaluates DeepSeekCoder, Qwen2.5-Coder, Magicoder, and instruction-tuned variants on Python benchmarks.

流程提取仓库概念、合成问题、采样十个代码候选和测试，再用受 PageRank 启发的分数排序候选。公共前缀和后缀匹配将每个回答对切分为前缀、分歧中段和后缀；分数间隔加共享上下文准则选择集中的易错点。

每个策略得到 5,000 条选中的训练示例和 1,000 条验证示例。报告的损失将中段权重设为二，训练十个轮次，并在 Python 基准上评估 DeepSeekCoder、Qwen2.5-Coder、Magicoder 及指令微调变体。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On the constructed analysis set, common prefix plus chosen middle has a 0.5651 correlation with final correctness, while prefix plus rejected middle has −0.6085; prefix and suffix alone are near zero. Continuing from the chosen middle gives 90.02% pass@1, versus 3.17% from the rejected middle.

Focused-DPO improves average relative accuracy by 4.79% on HumanEval(+) and MBPP(+) over the reported baselines. On LiveCodeBench Hard, Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct rises from 0.034 to 0.048, a 42.86% relative improvement, while its overall LiveCodeBench average rises from 0.312 to 0.339.

在构造的分析集上，公共前缀加优选中段与最终正确性的相关系数为 0.5651，而前缀加劣选中段为 −0.6085；单独前缀和后缀接近零。从优选中段继续生成的 pass@1 为 90.02%，从劣选中段继续为 3.17%。

Focused-DPO 在 HumanEval(+) 和 MBPP(+) 上比报告的基线平均相对准确率提高 4.79%。在 LiveCodeBench Hard 上，Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct 从 0.034 上升到 0.048，即 42.86% 的相对提升，其整体 LiveCodeBench 平均从 0.312 上升到 0.339。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper does not merely score whole programs more carefully. It creates a record whose supervision boundary is a test-sensitive divergent segment, then changes the loss to emphasize that segment. This connects executable failure analysis to the unit DPO consumes.

The construction uses generated tests and candidate agreement instead of costly manual localization. Its contribution is therefore both a way to select fine-grained preference records and an objective that preserves that record structure during optimization.

论文不只是更仔细地给完整程序评分。它创建一条监督边界为测试敏感分歧片段的记录，再改变损失以强调该片段。这把可执行失败分析连接到 DPO 消费的单位。

构造使用生成测试和候选一致性，而不是昂贵的人工定位。因此，它的贡献既是选择细粒度偏好记录的方法，也是优化时保留该记录结构的目标。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method depends on generated tests and ranking quality, so incorrect tests can misidentify the decisive segment. It is evaluated on Python and reported benchmarks, while real repositories can contain interacting errors that do not reduce to one shared-prefix pair. The data-generation and execution pipeline is also more expensive than ordinary offline DPO.
该方法依赖生成的测试和排序质量，因此错误测试可能误识别决定性片段。它在 Python 和报告基准上评估，而真实仓库可能包含不能化为单个共享前缀回答对的交互错误。数据生成和执行流程也比普通离线 DPO 更昂贵。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use Focused-DPO when executable feedback exists but whole-program preference pairs hide where correctness changes. It offers a concrete route from tests to localized training weights. It is less suitable for tasks without reliable execution or where generated tests cannot distinguish meaningful alternatives.
当存在可执行反馈、但完整程序偏好回答对隐藏正确性变化位置时，可使用 Focused-DPO。它提供从测试到局部训练权重的具体路径。对于没有可靠执行环境，或生成测试不能区分有意义替代方案的任务，它不太适合。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the segment-correlation analysis before the loss: it is the evidence for treating the middle as special. Then inspect the construction criterion, because test ranking and shared context determine whether the identified point is meaningful. Finally compare the LiveCodeBench table with absolute scores as well as relative gains, especially in the small Hard subset.
在阅读损失前先阅读片段相关性分析：它是把中段视为特殊部分的证据。然后检查构造准则，因为测试排序和共享上下文决定识别出的点是否有意义。最后同时比较 LiveCodeBench 表中的绝对分数和相对提升，尤其是较小的 Hard 子集。
